coastal.title: Lions Bay evacuation alert rescinded, Lone Tree Creek wildfire now being held
coastal.description: The Lone Tree Creek wildfire was spotted on Sunday afternoon, burning above Lions Bay in an area that was hard for firefighters to reach.

coastal.title: Wildfires surge as B.C. records 11,000 lightning strikes, but rain helps in battle
coastal.description: Lightning sparked new wildfires over the weekend and is the suspected cause of a wildfire that ignited in the Village of Lions Bay, located between Vancouver and Whistler.

coastal.title: Evacuation alert rescinded for wildfire burning near Lions Bay, B.C.
coastal.description: A wildfire-related evacuation alert for about 30 properties in a community just north of Vancouver has been rescinded after it was issued on Monday.

coastal.title: Renowned queer lawyer, activist barbara findlay dead at 77
coastal.description: Lesbian lawyer and activist barbara findlay died this weekend at the age of 77. B.C.'s 2SLGBTQ+ community is mourning her loss.

kamloops.title: Summerland residents gather for first Sunday market since wildfire evacuation
kamloops.description: For the first time since the Bald Range wildfire forced the evacuation of around 20,000 Summerland, B.C., properties earlier this month, residents gathered for the weekly community market.

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]
